name: GAN 16 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated)
description: Push your solves further with GAN’s next-gen flagship. This magnetic 3×3 combines MagLev tensioning for ultra-low friction with calibrated core-to-corner magnets that auto-align layers mid-turn. The result is a fast, stable, and remarkably controllable cube that rewards high TPS while minimizing lockups. A UV-coated, glossy shell resists scratches and keeps colors vivid for long practice sessions and competition use.
features: MagLev tensioning replaces springs to cut friction and maintain consistent feel over time
Core magnets pull layers into place for reliable auto-alignment and better corner-cutting
Factory-installed edge/corner magnets add a crisp, confident snap without harsh overshoot
UV-coated exterior is durable, easy to clean, and helps shades pop for quicker recognition
Balanced speed and stability tuned for both beginners and top speedcubers
Dual-adjust system lets you set overall tension and compression separately
